# Vendored TD SDK headers

`TOP_CPlusPlusBase.h` and `CPlusPlus_Common.h` are copied verbatim from
[TouchDesigner/CustomOperatorSamples](https://github.com/TouchDesigner/CustomOperatorSamples)
(`TOP/SpectrumTOP/`), TD 2025.3x API version 12.

Per the header's own license text: owned by Derivative Inc., usable and modifiable only
in conjunction with TouchDesigner, redistributable provided this notice and the
conditions in the header comment are retained. Do not edit these files directly — per
their own instruction, subclass `TOP_CPlusPlusBase` instead.
